ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black regions covering ~80% of the fluke; distinct high-contrast white mottling and blobs are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and in vertical streaks on the right medial lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations (peak-to-valley) between 5 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups concentrated on the lateral terminals of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and jaggedness along the continuous boundary of the trailing edge.
